messages:
rachel: Quick thread 1: Cobalt Edge wants a POC for a new variant (cobalt-edge-16b-adapt) for clinician chat + long-context embeddings. PHI involved. They asked: can we onboard, timeline, and ballpark for ~110M gen tokens + 7M embed tokens/mo?

omar: cobalt-edge-16b-adapt not in catalog. We can onboard but need model weights (HF/S3), tokenizer, license, sample prompts (~1k), max_context, and target latency SLO. Also confirm whether embeddings will be persisted/indexed.

lina: From infra: compact/adapter variant likely needs quantization candidates (q4_k/q5_k). For >16k context validate KV cache and per-token memory. If they want 32k, it affects GPU choice. Ask for a few long-doc samples.

marta: Security: PHI -> recommend Private or Dedicated with BAA. Need DPO contact, data flow diagram, and whether embeddings will hold PHI. If embeddings index PHI we require encrypted-at-rest indices, KMS-managed keys, and RBAC. Legal addendum ~2-3 weeks (possible blocker).

security-bot: questionnaire uploaded to deal binder.

billing-bot: Hosted list for that volume is costly. Options: committed Dedicated or mixed routing (embeds hosted, gen on Dedicated). Share peak concurrent streams and avg tokens/response and Ill sketch committed vs hosted costs.

omar: Onboarding plan: 1) artifacts + tokenizer + prompts. 2) tokenizer roundtrip + edge-case checks. 3) smoke forward pass. 4) quant candidates + perf sweep. 5) safety/quality evals (clinical extraction). 6) recommend deployment (Private/Dedicated if PHI). 7) canary + SLA.

lina: ETA: basic tokenizer + perf smoke = 2-3 business days if artifacts clean. Full quality + safety eval = +2 days. 32k tuning = +3 days. Optimistic 5 business days, realistic ~8.

marta: Legal/BAA timeline likely the blocker. Also confirm retention policy for embeddings and access controls.

rachel: Can someone drop a compact tokenizer check snippet I can send? I will request artifacts and 1k prompts now.

omar: Quick checks to include:
```
# tokenizer quick roundtrip
python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('path/to/tokenizer'); s=open('samples.txt').read().splitlines()[:200]; ids=[t(x)['input_ids'] for x in s]; print(sum(len(i) for i in ids))"
```
Smoke forward:
```
python -c "import torch; from model_loader import load_model; m=load_model('path/to/model'); x=torch.randint(0,32000,(1,128)); print(m(x).shape)"
```
Provide presigned S3 link (read-only) for upload. I can own perf sweep and post results.

lina: Ill run q4_k and q5_k candidates once artifacts available. Post perf matrix here.

billing-bot: Once we have avg seq length and peak rps Ill produce a hosted vs committed cost sketch.

rachel: Thanks team. Scheduling a customer sync for Fri and will update the deal doc.
